item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 15/Nov/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting the coastal areas of southern China will persist until early next week. Besides, the anticyclone aloft over southern China will weaken in the next couple of days. A broad band of clouds will bring one or two rain patches to the region. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach southern China midweek next week, bringing cooler weather to the region.
